verdict.rationale: Anthropic's spec and docs are explicit that every SKILL.md must document what it does and when Claude should use it via the required `description` frontmatter field (anthropic-skills-docs-17, -29, -32, -44), and Claude Code docs describe frontmatter controlling invocation and automatic loading (anthropic-skills-docs-3, -34, -25). However, multiple independent hands-on reports directly contradict the 'predict before surprised' promise: developers with properly formatted YAML/description skills report triggering is 'hit or miss', skills are ignored even when explicitly asked, and behavior only becomes reliable by bypassing the skill mechanism entirely and pasting instructions into AGENTS.md (anthropic-skills-comm-6, -7, -9, -10, -11, -12). This is a concrete, repeated hands-on contradiction of the documented activation-prediction claim, not mere skepticism. Missing for 10: evidence that documented 'when to use' triggers reliably match actual runtime activation, and no vendor rebuttal/fix addressing the triggering-unpredictability reports.
